[P2] Enforce the configured session lifetime

The validated timeout is discarded, and no subsequent operation uses `config.timeout`. A handler containing a 60-second durable wait therefore behaves identically with a one-second or one-hour timeout: cleanup only starts when the handler finishes. This contradicts `AgentcoreSessionConfig.timeout`, which promises a session lifetime including durable waits. Enforce a replay-stable session deadline and stop the session on expiry, with regression coverage spanning suspension and replay.
